title: Create a TestDisk FreeDos LiveCD
comment: This document explains how to create under Linux a LiveCD running FreeDOS that automatically start TestDisk . Download FreeDOS OEM CD-ROM disc builder assistant wget -N http://www.fdos.org/bootdisks/ISO/FDOEMCD.builder.zip Download the DOS version of TestDisk & PhotoRec wget -N http://www.cgsecurity.org/testdisk-6.11.3.dos.zip Cleanup the work directory if it already exists rm -rf FDOEMCD
